World design

Morrowfen

Flood gauges disagree with the tide. Craft repaired instruments, fish local species and trace diverted water to the coast.

Climate, lighting and weather

Misty wetland with low sun, periodic heavy rain and limited lightning flashes under accessibility settings.

Factions

River Compact; Tidebound League

Settlement and service placement

Reedgate stilt camp has fisher, cook, repair vendor and shrine. Raised boardwalk loop connects quest contacts without swimming.

Travel-time tests

Proposed 3–4 minute boardwalk loop and 5-minute camp-to-estuary route; swimming is an optional shortcut, not the only service access.

Environmental hazards

Deep channels, slow-mud volumes with explicit tags and low-visibility fog. Mark shore exits and avoid hidden lethal water.

Quest arc and consequences

Flood gauges disagree with the tide. Craft repaired instruments, fish local species and trace diverted water to the coast.

Landmarks and discovery

Sunken Bellhouse; Reedgate Gauge; Blackwater Causeway

Enemy families

Fen skitters (18–22); Mudhorn grazers (20–25); Drowned sentries (24–28)

Ore distribution

BogIron: dry hummocks; SiltCrystal: rare rock islands

Tree distribution

WillowBranch: banks; Bogwood: elevated dead stands

Fish species pools

MudPike: channels; LanternCarp: still pools; MarshEel: storm modifier optional

Music and ambience

Low reeds, water insects and soft percussion; subtitled/visual hazard warnings.

3D art production requirements

Stilt-house and boardwalk kit, water/shore masks, swamp vegetation, fog volumes and enemy sheets.

Optimization and streaming

Bound translucent overdraw, weather particle count and expensive water reflections. Collision/navmesh separates boardwalk heights from water.

Gate authoring

Author dry clear arrival spawns outside trigger bounds. Validate compatible build/capacity/eligibility before issuing a ticket. Gate labels are not stable identity; use the listed IDs. The reciprocal pair is checked by the documentation validator.

Concrete production and test steps

  1. Create the map/definition according to the asset pages; only activate the first-phase portion now.
  2. Graybox services/roads/water with legal primitives and validate capsule/navigation before art replacement.
  3. Register stable site/gate/encounter/NPC/objective IDs through the existing schemas.
  4. Assign current-phase references in zone runtime and run two-client admission/travel tests.
  5. Fish cast intersects approved pool and shore line of sight.
  6. Swim-to-boardwalk exit cannot clip underside.
  7. Weather transition does not reroll an active fishing attempt.
  8. Fog and large text preserve objective/telegraph readability.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
